name: agent-kingdom
description: The Herald: brings the Agent Guild into each session. Tells the guild when the session waits on a permission prompt, shows your hero in the status line, and adds /guild.

guild_url.title: Guild URL
guild_url.description: Where the guild runs (npm start). Loopback only: 127.0.0.1, localhost or ::1.

token_file.title: Token file
token_file.description: The file holding the guild's token. It is sent only as Authorization: Bearer.
